$doc: User flows — the intent layer. graph.json is the mechanism (what every control does); this file says which journeys the product owes, in words a person can check. `check-flows.mjs` resolves each one against the graph by searching `advance` edges alone and writes the result to flows.resolved.json, the committed witness. A flow declares: `name` (kebab-case) · `description` (its intent in one line) · `start` · optional `waypoints` · `end`. START is either a board (`{board}` — the journey begins on that screen), a given edge (`{board, via}` plus `case`/`to` when that edge offers several outcomes), or a CONTROL (`{control}` — the click, not the screen: it expands to every edge carrying that label, which must all land on the same first board; `except` drops boards that mean something else there, and `case`/`to` narrows a control whose outcome depends on what it was pressed on — a post's media opens a picture's post or a portrait clip's stream, one control, two journeys). END is a given edge `{board, via}` (plus `case`/`to`), the concluding act. A flow may OMIT `end` instead, and then concludes on ARRIVAL at the board its last point lands on — the start's landing board when it declares no waypoints, the last waypoint's board when it does; the witness reads `end · arrival at <Board>`. That is the shape of a reading journey, which reaches what it came for and has no signing act to name. A GAP counts differently at the two ends: on an end it resolves the flow as BLOCKED, an honest claim on design still owed, while on a start it FAILS, because a journey that can begin from no existing screen is an authoring error rather than a claim. So a given start edge that opens a gap fails, and so does a control whose every origin reaches only a gap; a control with merely some such origins resolves and lists them under `startsUndesigned`. WAYPOINTS are ordered boards the journey passes through; a waypoint's `via` (with `case` or `to`) pins the edge the flow LEAVES that board by, which is how an ambiguous leg is settled — to pin the very first step, name the start board as the first waypoint. Start and end edges are given, never searched, so their kind does not matter; every leg between two points is searched, and a leg that resolves two ways is a hard failure asking for a pin. FORMATTING: one flow per block, one waypoint per line, hand-edited. Never let a script rewrite this file.

flows.name: publish-a-post
flows.description: The bottom nav's New post opens the wizard on every tab root; pictures are cropped, described, and signed into the feed.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: edit-avatar-standalone
flows.description: The change badge on your own profile picture goes straight to the crop and its own seal — one signature, the picture alone.

end.case: signed — shown everywhere you appear

flows.name: edit-avatar-via-edit-screen
flows.description: Changing the picture from the edit screen returns to it — one seal covers the picture and the fields together.

waypoints.case: come from the edit screen — the edit's one seal signs it

end.case: signed — the profile updates

flows.name: narrow-the-feed
flows.description: The band's filter trigger opens the filter sheet; the chips stage, and Done commits — the feed re-queries once and the reader lands on the narrowed feed.

end.case: narrowed — the feed re-queries once

flows.name: sign-in
flows.description: Email and password on the sign-in screen land a member with their key on this device in their own feed.

end.case: member, key on this device

flows.name: reply-to-a-post
flows.description: The comment count, wherever a post is drawn, opens the thread sheet; Add a comment opens the composer, and the seal signs the reply back into the thread.

end.case: signed — the thread reopened where it was left, the reply settling on its parent

flows.name: open-a-topic
flows.description: A tag chip on a post opens that tag's page — everything its author tagged, newest claim first, each row carrying the pair it was tagged with.

flows.name: sign-in-with-the-key-elsewhere
flows.description: The same sign-in on a device the key is not on — reading runs, and anything signed waits until the key is restored.

end.case: member, key not here

flows.name: join-with-an-invite
flows.description: An invite link checks out at the door, then handle, email and password make the account and the applicant days begin.

end.case: account created — applicant days begin

flows.name: guest-turns-applicant
flows.description: Sign in or join, offered on every guest screen, runs a visitor who holds no link out to the invite and through Create account into the applicant days.

end.case: account created — applicant days begin

flows.name: join-with-the-link-in-hand
flows.description: A visitor who arrived through a live invite link presses Sign in or join and meets the join form with the link already held — never the door, never a second paste.

end.case: account created — applicant days begin

flows.name: verify-the-email
flows.description: Back to CoGra in the verification mail returns an applicant to the feed their application still runs in.

end.case: application still running

flows.name: verify-the-email-as-a-member
flows.description: The same mail opened once the application has been approved lands a full member in their own feed.

end.case: already a member

flows.name: make-your-key
flows.description: Create my key runs the ceremony — the recovery code shown, written down, confirmed — and hands the applicant back where it began.

end.case: code confirmed — returns where the ceremony began, the snackbar Key made and backed up. saying so

flows.name: make-a-recovery-code-later
flows.description: A reader who declined the backup opens the Recovery code row, makes the code on the ceremony's own board, types it back, and lands in settings with the key backed up.

end.case: a code made or replaced from settings — confirmed, the backup uploads, and the snackbar says so

flows.name: vouch-back-for-your-inviter
flows.description: Vouch back on the approval landing opens the stance pad; the signed stance completes the pair; the ceremony says so, and the member's own feed opens.

waypoints.case: the vouch-back — signed, the ceremony opens

flows.name: send-someone-an-invite
flows.description: Invites on your own profile makes a link — one person and seven days unless the reader says otherwise — and hands it straight to the platform's own share sheet.

end.case: the platform's own share sheet

flows.name: vouch-an-applicant-in
flows.description: A ready application in the invites queue opens the stance pad on the applicant; Set signs the inviter's opinion, which is the approval and the vouch in one act.

flows.name: answer-someones-ask-link
flows.description: An ask link lands on the person who sent it; opening the stance affordance raises the pad, and Set signs the vouch that brings them in — the route a turned-down applicant still has.

end.case: signed — the vouch lands and the person is now this member's to have vouched in; the standard signed-opinion snackbar answers

flows.name: meet-an-ask-link-that-names-nobody
flows.description: An ask link whose id resolves to nobody says so in JoinInvalid's idiom, and its arrow returns the reader to whatever the link opened over.

flows.name: restore-your-key
flows.description: Restore the key, wherever the key-absent screens offer it, takes the recovery code and returns to whatever was waiting on it.

end.case: key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: take-a-stance-on-a-post
flows.description: Tap the stance face, wherever a post is drawn, and the pad blooms; the signed stance lands back where it was taken.

end.case: signed — the stance lands, back where the pad bloomed

flows.name: close-the-filter-unchanged
flows.description: The filter sheet dismissed leaves the feed exactly as it was — whatever was staged is dropped, and nothing re-queries.

flows.name: filter-the-feed-to-nothing
flows.description: Every kind switched off leaves a feed with nothing left to show — the empty state carrying its own way back.

end.case: everything off — the feed re-queries once

flows.name: filter-the-feed-far-from-the-default
flows.description: A filter pushed far enough from the default that the trigger counts the changes instead of naming them.

end.case: far from the default — the feed re-queries once

flows.name: undo-the-narrowing
flows.description: A feed filtered until nothing shows offers Show posts again — the one control that puts the default back.

flows.name: search-into-a-thread
flows.description: Typing in Explore brings results as they are typed; a comment result opens the thread that comment sits in.

flows.name: narrow-a-search
flows.description: The results' Everything trigger opens the search filter; the chips stage, and Done commits — the search re-queries once and the reader lands on the narrowed results.

flows.name: reply-to-a-comment
flows.description: Reply on a comment opens the same composer pre-targeted at it — one commenting mechanism over many targets, each target declaring its own start and end.

start.case: the composer, pre-targeted at that comment

end.case: signed — the thread reopened where it was left, the reply settling on its parent

flows.name: reply-with-pictures
flows.description: Pictures added to a reply land in its tray; one seal signs the words and the pictures together into the thread.

end.case: signed — the thread reopened where it was left, the reply settling on its parent

flows.name: reply-with-a-video
flows.description: A video picked for a reply puts the composer in its video state, where its face is chosen and its one description written; the same seal signs the words and the clip together into the thread.

waypoints.case: a video — the composer's video state

end.case: signed — the thread reopened where it was left, the reply settling on its parent

flows.name: reply-while-the-pictures-upload
flows.description: Next pressed while the pictures are still going up reaches the reply's own gated seal; signing waits for them, then the comment settles into the thread.

start.case: uploads still running — the reply's gated seal

end.case: uploads land — signing proceeds to the thread reopened where it was left, the reply settling on its parent

flows.name: edit-your-comment
flows.description: Edit on your own comment opens the edit surface; the signed edit settles back into the thread it belongs to.

end.case: signed — the thread reopened where it was left, the edit settling on its card

flows.name: publish-words
flows.description: Write words instead takes the wizard's other half — no crop, no cover, the same details and the same seal signing words alone into the feed.

waypoints.case: the body empty — the words stage, no ask

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: publish-a-video
flows.description: A horizontal or square clip takes a step of its own — the cover picks the face the post wears, and details and seal follow the way pictures do.

waypoints.case: a horizontal or square video — its face

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: publish-a-vertical-video
flows.description: A vertical clip meets no cover step at all: it plays the moment it is on screen, so its face is its first frame and the wizard runs pick to details, where an optional door offers a cover to anyone who wants one.

waypoints.case: a vertical video — no cover step, the door waits on details

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: give-a-vertical-clip-a-cover
flows.description: The door on details opens the step the clip skipped; the face chosen there comes back to the stage that asked, and the post signs from it.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: cite-something
flows.description: + Cite something, wherever a composer offers it, opens the picker over everything citable; a result row stages the citation in the composer's references, and the picker stays open for the next.

end.case: the pick stages in the composer's references — the row leaves the results for the staged section above them, wearing its ×, and the picker stays open for the next

flows.name: set-your-own-stance-on-your-post
flows.description: Adjust on the seal blooms the one-axis pad — your own post always reaches you in full, so the stance is declared before signing, never assumed.

flows.name: pick-a-kept-draft-back-up
flows.description: New post with a draft kept asks before it opens; Continue resumes that draft at details, and the same seal signs it into the feed.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: edit-your-post
flows.description: The own-post overflow offers Edit; the edit surface carries its changes as signed acts of their own and the post settles with them.

end.case: signed — the post, the edit settling

flows.name: remove-your-post
flows.description: Remove asks once, then leaves the mark — the post is redacted where it stood, never silently erased.

flows.name: remove-your-comment
flows.description: Your own comment's menu carries Remove; it asks once, then leaves the mark — the comment is redacted where it stood in its thread, its replies still under it, never silently erased.

flows.name: set-the-cover-and-order
flows.description: Show all opens the picked batch as a list; dragging sets the order, the first picture is the cover, and Done returns wherever the sheet opened.

flows.name: describe-your-pictures
flows.description: Describe the pictures, wherever pictures are staged, opens the sheet; what is written there is witnessed at signing and never gates the upload.

flows.name: publish-while-the-uploads-run
flows.description: Details written while the pictures are still climbing reach the gated seal; signing waits for them, then the post lands in its detail view, still settling.

end.case: uploads land — signing proceeds to the detail view, still settling

flows.name: see-who-stands-with-someone
flows.description: The figures row, on any profile, opens the stance lists; reading who stands with them is the whole journey.

flows.name: find-the-thread-a-comment-answers
flows.description: A chronicle's Comments tab draws each comment with what it answers; the target pointer opens that post, its thread already open.

flows.name: edit-your-profile
flows.description: Edit profile opens the fields — name, bio, website — and one seal signs them; the picture has flows of its own.

end.case: signed — the profile updates

flows.name: take-a-stance-on-a-person
flows.description: Tap the stance anchor on a profile and the same pad blooms; the stance concludes where it was taken.

end.case: signed — the stance lands, back where the pad bloomed

flows.name: message-someone
flows.description: Message on someone's profile lands on the chats screen, which says the surface is not here yet — the conversation itself is still owed.

flows.name: publish-from-the-browser
flows.description: A browser draws its own pick step — files dropped on the page, no device tray — and the wizard rejoins at the crop, ending on the same seal as the native one.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: reply-from-the-browser
flows.description: In a browser the reply's pictures are dropped anywhere on the page; the tray, the words and the seal are the native ones, and one signature lands the comment in its thread.

end.case: signed — the thread reopened where it was left, the reply settling on its parent

flows.name: visit-an-author
flows.description: The author chip, wherever a post is drawn, opens that person's profile; their chronicle is what the reader came for.

flows.name: open-a-posts-pictures
flows.description: Post media, wherever a post is drawn, opens the post itself — a reader scrolling is choosing between posts, and the post is where the frames are whole.

flows.name: watch-the-stream
flows.description: A portrait clip's tap, wherever a post is drawn, opens the stream — the reader's own ranked feed narrowed to clips taller than they are wide, swiped onward from there.

start.case: a portrait clip — the stream opens

flows.name: reel-to-detail
flows.description: The score element on the stream's rail is the detail door: the clip squishes to the top of the screen, still playing, and the post rises beneath it — tapping the pinned clip expands it back into the stream, the reader's place held.

flows.name: open-the-viewer
flows.description: Media tapped again from the post's own view opens the fullscreen viewer — the frame whole, which is what every crop in the product is measured against.

flows.name: follow-a-citation
flows.description: The reference count, wherever a post is drawn, opens the topics-and-references sheet; a reference row opens what was cited — a cited post opens its own detail view.

flows.name: search-and-open-a-post
flows.description: Typing in Explore brings results as they are typed; a post result opens that post's own detail view.

flows.name: add-a-topic
flows.description: + Add a tag on the details step opens the picker, where any legal name is pickable — used or not, since nothing is ever created.

flows.name: cite-a-post
flows.description: The reader's overflow — on a post or on a comment, the same two rows — opens the post wizard fresh, the thing cited riding along unseen. The journey ends at the details stage, where the reference is finally on screen.

waypoints.case: the body empty — the words stage, no ask

flows.name: mention-someone
flows.description: Mention in a new post on another's profile stages exactly what citing stages — a Reference edge. The word records only that the far end is a person, and the wizard it opens is the same one.

waypoints.case: the body empty — the words stage, no ask

flows.name: request-account-deletion
flows.description: Settings' last row explains what goes and what stays, takes the content sweep as an opt-in, and ends where the flow leaves the app: a link mailed to the account's own address. Everything after that — the seven days, the band, the cancel — begins at the confirmation, which is not a tap of ours.

end.case: the request is recorded with its opt-in and the link is on its way — nothing is scheduled until the link is opened

flows.name: trace-a-score-to-its-records
flows.description: The Feed score, on every ranked card of every kind, opens why the thing reached this reader: the paths from their own opinions to it, strongest first. A path opens its steps, a step opens what carries it, and behind that step stand the signed records themselves — the floor of the whole claim, and a reading journey that concludes on reaching them. The stream's score is excepted: on the rail it is the detail door and not this one.

flows.name: who-holds-an-opinion-on-this
flows.description: The quiet count under a post's tags opens the list of everyone who holds an opinion on it — ungated, the profile's own opinions page mirrored onto content. A reading journey: reaching the list is the whole of it, and a row out of it is a visit to a person, which is its own flow.

flows.name: request-a-password-reset
flows.description: Forgot password? on the sign-in screen asks for the address and sends the reset link; the status line confirms the same whether or not an account stands behind it, and the journey leaves the app with the mail.

end.case: the status line confirms — always, no account enumeration

flows.name: set-a-new-password
flows.description: The reset mail's link opens the new-password form; the new password set signs every device out, so signing in again is the next thing.

flows.name: meet-a-spent-reset-link
flows.description: A reset link opened spent or past its fifteen minutes says so, and Reset your password asks for a fresh one, its field empty.

flows.name: sign-back-in-after-the-session-ran-out
flows.description: A session that ran out mid-use lands on the sign-in form; signing in again returns a member to the feed, the draft and any picks still kept.

flows.name: sign-in-after-a-wrong-password
flows.description: A pair that doesn't match answers in place on the sign-in form; the corrected pair signs a member with their key on this device into their feed.

flows.name: sign-in-after-the-backoff
flows.description: Too many failed tries in a row answer with the backoff in place; once it has passed, Sign in lands wherever app-open lands for the account.

flows.name: meet-the-security-notice
flows.description: A sign-in after a reused sign-in was detected lands with the notice as a card, once; Change password on it opens the credential screen, and the changed password signs every other device out.

flows.name: sign-in-where-no-backup-can-restore
flows.description: A member signing in on a device the key is not on, for an account with no backup, lands wherever app-open lands for that account — the key-elsewhere shell with nothing to restore from.

flows.name: arrive-through-an-invite-link
flows.description: An invite link opens the issuer's borrowed view, feed first; Sign in or join meets the join form with the link already in hand, and Create account begins the applicant days.

end.case: account created — applicant days begin

flows.name: arrive-through-a-dead-invite-link
flows.description: An invite link that no longer works still opens the borrowed view; Sign in or join says the link is unusable and takes another, and a different link that checks out opens the join form.

flows.name: paste-something-that-isnt-a-link
flows.description: Nothing that reads as a link at the door is answered in place on the field; a link that checks out then opens the join form.

flows.name: fix-the-join-forms-errors
flows.description: A handle taken or an input refused answers in place on the join form; corrected, Create account makes the account and the applicant days begin.

end.case: account created — applicant days begin

flows.name: a-guest-meets-the-join-ask
flows.description: A signed act tried in the bare view — the stance face on a post — raises the join prompt over the read; Sign in or join opens the sign-in screen for a reader who holds no link.

flows.name: verify-the-email-in-the-app
flows.description: The verification mail's link opened where the app takes it lands on the in-app confirmation; Go to the feed returns an applicant to the task cards still left.

flows.name: meet-a-spent-verification-link
flows.description: A verification link opened spent or timed out says so; Resend the link sends a fresh one, the status line saying so the same whether or not the account is already verified.

end.case: a fresh link goes out — the same act the applicant feed's card offers; a status line under the pair says so in Reset's construction, the same whether or not the account is already verified

flows.name: correct-an-applicants-address
flows.description: Wrong address? on the applicant's card changes an address not yet verified with the new one alone; a fresh link goes to it, and the card prints where it went.

flows.name: post-while-an-applicant
flows.description: An applicant's first post runs the same wizard and the same seal; signing stages it with the application, the wizard closing onto the applicant's own feed, and the post waits in their chronicle, seen by them alone.

flows.name: watch-the-registration-land
flows.description: Once the approval is given the applicant's card flips where the reader stands while the device signs the registration — a machine's step, read rather than tapped; the landing itself opens the vouch-back.

flows.name: ask-another-member-to-vouch
flows.description: The notification that an inviter closed the application opens the turned-down shell, where the ask link stands; copying it hands the reader a link that does not expire, for as many members as they know.

flows.name: read-your-own-page-as-an-applicant
flows.description: The Profile tab in the applicant days opens the reader's own page in its applicant state — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: make-your-key-without-a-backup
flows.description: Not now at the ceremony asks once whether to go on without a backup; I accept the risk makes the key alone and returns where the ceremony began, the snackbar saying so.

end.case: key without backup — returns where the ceremony began, and the snackbar says so

flows.name: meet-a-browser-that-cant-hold-a-key
flows.description: Create my key in a browser that cannot hold one says so before minting anything, and offers the app instead.

flows.name: type-the-recovery-code-back-wrong
flows.description: A typed-back code that diverges from the one shown is answered at once, on the typing, and the button never enables; typed right, the key is made and backed up and the ceremony returns where it began.

end.case: code confirmed — returns where the ceremony began, the snackbar Key made and backed up. saying so

flows.name: restore-your-key-as-an-applicant
flows.description: An applicant signed in where their key is not finds the key card on their own shell; Restore the key takes the recovery code and returns to it with the key here.

end.case: key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: make-a-new-key-in-place-of-the-attached-one
flows.description: Make a new key on the applicant's key card runs the ceremony again; its end replaces the key attached elsewhere.

end.case: code confirmed — returns where the ceremony began, the snackbar Key made and backed up. saying so

flows.name: restore-after-a-mistyped-code
flows.description: A recovery code of the wrong length is the one shape the reader can fix, and the field says so; the right length that still doesn't check out says that instead, and the code that does restores the key where restore began.

end.case: key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: sign-the-picks-kept-while-the-key-was-away
flows.description: A key restored with picks kept pending opens their review, every pick in one batch the reader looks over first; Sign them reaches the standard seal, and one signature lands them all, still settling.

end.case: signed, all together — back where the review was opened from, with the snackbar Signed 3 things, still settling.; each target's anchor wears Still settling until its record is ordered, and the settings row is gone

flows.name: take-a-stance-without-the-key
flows.description: The stance face, tapped or held where the key is elsewhere, opens the pad carrying the key notice; Keep it pending keeps the pick on this device, and the post's anchor wears it.

flows.name: meet-an-ask-link-that-cant-be-taken-up
flows.description: An ask link that can stage nobody right now says so; when the person has already landed, their profile is one tap on, where the member can look and give an opinion.

flows.name: watch-the-intro
flows.description: The first authenticated feed entry opens the intro over the feed once; its five cards run to Start reading, which ends where Skip ends — the applicant days.

flows.name: watch-the-intro-again
flows.description: Watch the intro again in settings is the one way back to the intro once it has been seen; it runs from the first card and ends back on settings.

flows.name: change-your-password
flows.description: The Password row asks for the current password and a new one; the change answers with the snackbar, and every other device is signed out.

flows.name: change-your-handle
flows.description: The Handle row takes the new handle; a well-formed one meets the think-twice dialog naming the cost before anything is sent, and Change it lands the handle on the row.

flows.name: change-your-email
flows.description: The Email row takes the new address and the current password and sends both messages; the code from the current address is typed here, and with the new address's link clicked too the address moves.

flows.name: confirm-the-email-change-from-the-new-address
flows.description: The new address's verification link, opened signed in, applies its side; when it is the last side the change lands and settings reads the new address.

end.case: the link was the last side — the change applied, and the row reads the new address

flows.name: open-the-new-address-link-signed-out
flows.description: The same link opened where no session is asks for sign-in first, since the proof counts only signed in; signed in, its side applies, and when it was the first side the code from the old address is still owed.

flows.name: finish-a-pending-email-change
flows.description: Settings with an email change in flight leads the Email row back to the side still owed; the code confirmed with the link already clicked moves the address.

flows.name: call-off-an-email-change
flows.description: Cancel the change on the confirmation calls a change in flight off without asking first — a change is started again from the row — and settings reads the address alone.

flows.name: replace-the-recovery-code
flows.description: The Recovery code row, with the key on this browser, takes the current code as proof and makes a new one on the ceremony's own board; typed back, the new backup uploads and settings says so.

flows.name: replace-the-recovery-code-after-a-refused-one
flows.description: A current code that doesn't check out is answered on the replace screen itself; the right one goes on to the new code, typed back the same way.

flows.name: replace-the-recovery-code-on-a-phone-without-a-lock
flows.description: On an Android phone with no screen lock the replace warns before the unlock that isn't there; Go on anyway shows the new code, typed back the same way.

flows.name: restore-the-key-from-the-recovery-code-row
flows.description: The Recovery code row with the key elsewhere has nothing to re-encrypt and offers Restore the key, which returns to settings with the key here.

end.case: key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: see-your-key
flows.description: The Your key row, after the platform's own unlock, shows the key, and either form of it goes to the clipboard with the snackbar saying Copied.

flows.name: see-your-key-behind-the-browsers-gate
flows.description: A browser whose seed is sealed behind the backup asks for the current recovery code first; the code opens the backup, the key is shown, and nothing is re-persisted.

flows.name: see-your-key-on-a-phone-without-a-lock
flows.description: On an Android phone with no screen lock the Your key row warns before the unlock that isn't there; Go on anyway shows the key.

flows.name: restore-the-key-from-the-your-key-row
flows.description: The Your key row with the key elsewhere asks for no unlock, since nothing stands behind it to reveal, and offers Restore the key instead.

end.case: key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: set-the-default-license
flows.description: Default license opens the seal's own license question over settings; Done sets what every new post starts from, never the last one.

flows.name: set-what-every-feed-opens-with
flows.description: What your feed shows opens the feed's own filter over settings; Done saves the default every feed opens with, and the row reads it back.

flows.name: read-whats-new
flows.description: What's new opens the release chronicle, newest first, the version running here marked; a release's own page on GitHub is one tap away.

flows.name: update-from-whats-new
flows.description: What's new opened while this version is behind the newest release offers Update now — the app's store listing, or on the web a reload into the new version.

end.case: the app: CoGra's Play Store listing (a placeholder id until published — https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=local.cogra.app)

flows.name: report-a-problem
flows.description: Report a problem opens an empty field with Send by email live all the same; what is written goes into the reader's own mail with the four facts and the report address filled in, and nothing leaves until it is sent there.

flows.name: unhide-an-account
flows.description: Hidden accounts opens the hidden list over settings; Unhide takes a row away and their posts return to the feed, the snackbar answering.

end.case: the row goes and their posts return to your feed — the snackbar answers

flows.name: read-about-cogra
flows.description: About CoGra opens the whole page from settings — each topic unfolding on its own; reading it is the whole journey.

flows.name: sign-out
flows.description: Sign out on a remembered device ends the session and keeps the account offered on the sign-in screen.

end.case: remembered — the session ends and the account stays offered here

flows.name: sign-out-without-a-backup
flows.description: Sign out where this device holds the only copy of an unbacked key asks first; Sign out, keep them locked ends the session with the key, the draft and any kept picks sealed on this device until the account signs in here again.

flows.name: confirm-the-account-deletion
flows.description: The deletion mail's link is the confirmation, signed in or not; Go to the feed opens the feed under the deletion band, which rides every signed-in surface until the deadline.

flows.name: cancel-the-deletion-from-the-feed
flows.description: Cancel on the deletion band abandons the request before the deadline; the band goes and the snackbar answers, nothing having been redacted yet.

flows.name: cancel-the-deletion-from-settings
flows.description: Settings during the grace reads the deadline on its Delete account row; the row opens it in full with Cancel, which calls the deletion off and returns to settings with the band gone.

flows.name: choose-a-posts-license
flows.description: Change on the seal's license row opens the license sheet; Done closes it onto the seal, the row reading the pair's name and both tier hints.

flows.name: mark-a-post-sensitive
flows.description: Mark on the seal's sensitive row opens the sheet, where the switch and its reason are staged; Done closes it onto the seal, the row reading the mark.

flows.name: publish-with-the-key-elsewhere
flows.description: Sign and publish where the key is elsewhere reaches the key-absent seal; Restore the key takes the recovery code and returns to the seal it began from, the draft intact.

end.case: key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: write-past-the-details-caps
flows.description: A description past the five hundred stops Next and says so on the field; cutting it clears the refusal the moment it fits.

flows.name: write-past-the-words-cap
flows.description: A words body past the five thousand says how far over and stops Next; cutting clears the refusal the moment it fits.

flows.name: look-over-many-staged-citations
flows.description: A seal carrying more than one citation counts them on its References row, and the count opens what it counts; a staged citation's name opens its pair, and Done carries the pair it was given.

flows.name: look-over-many-staged-tags
flows.description: A seal carrying more tags than its row holds counts them, and the count opens the staged-tags sheet; a tag's name opens its pair, and Done carries the pair it was given.

flows.name: pair-a-staged-citation
flows.description: A staged reference row on the details stage opens the citation's pair sheet; the pair moves, nothing signs until the seal, and Done carries it back to the row.

flows.name: discard-a-kept-draft
flows.description: Reaching past a kept draft to the dimmed roll is asking to discard it, and the dialog asks; Discard it brings the roll live and a fresh pick begins.

flows.name: swap-the-pictures-for-words
flows.description: Write words instead with pictures or a clip already in the body asks first; Discard lets them go and opens the words stage empty, the rest of the draft kept.

flows.name: pick-files-that-are-refused
flows.description: Picks over the cap or in a format nothing here reads are named on the pick step with why; what was accepted goes on to the crop.

flows.name: pick-a-video-from-the-grid
flows.description: A video picked from the grid becomes the whole body and the step stops taking picks; a horizontal or square clip goes on to choose its face, and details and the seal follow.

flows.name: go-back-to-a-clip-wearing-its-cover
flows.description: Back from the cover step once a face is chosen shows the pick with the clip wearing it; Next returns to the cover step, which holds the choice rather than asking again.

flows.name: cover-a-clip-with-a-picture-of-your-own
flows.description: A picture of your own on the cover step comes back through the crop, locked to the video's shape; Next sets it as the cover on the row that asked.

flows.name: preview-the-clip-before-choosing-its-face
flows.description: Play on the cover step runs the preview, the transport in place of the cover; the face is still picked from the strip, and Next goes on to details.

flows.name: cover-a-clip-the-device-cant-cut
flows.description: A horizontal or square clip the device returns no frames for meets the cover step with the gallery alone; with a cover or without one, Next goes on to details — a post never waits on a frame the device could not cut.

flows.name: describe-a-video
flows.description: Describe the video on a clip's details opens the describe sheet's video shape — one description for the whole clip, none for its cover.

flows.name: name-a-new-tag
flows.description: Typing in the tag picker canonicalizes the name as it goes and keeps it the first row; picking it stages it in the composer's tags, and the picker stays open for the next.

flows.name: meet-a-tag-name-it-cant-take
flows.description: A character no name may carry is refused where it was typed and nothing stages; with the offending characters gone the first row comes back.

flows.name: publish-past-a-cited-post-that-never-landed
flows.description: A cited post that never landed is named on its own seal row with Remove it; the refused act removed, Sign and publish lands the post in its detail view, still settling.

flows.name: keep-the-draft-when-signing-is-refused
flows.description: The write rule refusing the seal stages and spends nothing; Keep the draft, sign later leaves with the draft on this device, offered back the next time you compose.

end.case: leaves — the draft stays on this device and is offered back the next time you compose

flows.name: try-again-after-a-bug
flows.description: Any other refusal of a staged act is a bug the notice owns; Try again that goes through this time lands the post in its detail view, still settling.

flows.name: report-a-bug-from-the-seal
flows.description: Report a problem on the bug notice opens the same report page Settings opens, nothing about the seal attached — the words are the reader's own.

flows.name: discard-the-post-from-the-bug-notice
flows.description: Discard the post on the bug notice asks first, since the draft would be lost; Discard it leaves the flow back where composing began, nothing signed.

flows.name: retry-a-post-after-the-network-drops
flows.description: Sign and publish offline meets the network-error board; Retry that reaches this time lands the post in its detail view, still settling.

flows.name: read-a-help-dialog
flows.description: A ? opens its help dialog — on the seal, the Signed-actions text; Close returns to the screen that asked.

flows.name: save-a-comment
flows.description: Save on a comment's menu keeps the comment in the one Saved list beside posts and people.

end.case: the comment is kept — it joins the one Saved list beside posts and people

flows.name: read-a-comments-license
flows.description: License terms on a comment's menu closes the menu and brings the comment's terms up in a sheet over the thread — reading them is the whole of it.

flows.name: see-who-holds-an-opinion-on-a-comment
flows.description: Opinions on this, on a comment's menu, brings the holders up over the thread — drawn in the state a comment nobody has answered leaves it.

flows.name: see-what-cites-a-comment
flows.description: Cited by, on a comment's menu, brings what cites the comment up over the thread — drawn in the state nothing citing it leaves it, which is the only door that state has.

flows.name: adjust-a-replys-stance
flows.description: Adjust on the reply's seal opens the reply pad, the stance toward what the reply answers; Set puts the adjusted stance on the seal.

flows.name: read-the-reply-pads-help
flows.description: The reply pad's ? opens its own help topic — the post pad's text would say the opposite of what is true here; Close returns to the pad.

flows.name: reply-carrying-a-citation
flows.description: A reference picked for a reply comes back staged on the reply's seal; Sign comment settles the reply and its reference on its parent, the thread reopened where it was left.

flows.name: reply-carrying-many-citations
flows.description: A reply with several references staged counts them on its seal; Sign comment settles the reply and its references on its parent, the thread reopened where it was left.

flows.name: reply-with-the-key-elsewhere
flows.description: A key that left while the reply was written meets Sign comment with the reply-scale fallback; Restore the key returns to the seal with the reply intact.

end.case: key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: reply-at-the-door-without-the-key
flows.description: Add a comment where the key is elsewhere meets the notice at the door, before a word is written; Restore the key takes the recovery code and returns where it began.

end.case: key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: sign-a-reply-after-an-upload-failed
flows.description: An upload that doesn't land while the reply's seal waits disables Sign comment and drops any held press; Retry starts it again, and the reply settles once the uploads land.

flows.name: discard-a-reply
flows.description: Leaving a reply with something written asks first; Discard returns to the thread, the words gone.

flows.name: retry-a-clip-that-didnt-upload
flows.description: A reply's clip that didn't upload keeps Next disabled until it is retried or removed; Retry starts the upload again.

flows.name: reply-with-files-refused
flows.description: Picks over the reply's cap or in a format nothing here reads are named in the composer with why; what was accepted goes on with the words to the seal.

flows.name: edit-a-video-comment
flows.description: Editing a comment whose body is a clip offers its description and its cover; the signed edit settles on its card, the thread reopened where it was left.

flows.name: see-what-a-comment-edit-signs
flows.description: The count at the foot of a comment edit opens the acts it will sign; Done closes them back onto the edit.

flows.name: leave-an-edit-unchanged
flows.description: An edit opened and left as it was found has nothing staged, so Sign the edit stays disabled and leaving keeps and discards nothing.

flows.name: see-what-a-post-edit-signs
flows.description: The count at the foot of a post edit opens the acts it will sign; Done closes them back onto the edit.

flows.name: edit-a-video-post
flows.description: Editing a post whose body is a clip offers its description and a cover of your own; the signed edit settles on the post, the new cover pointed at.

end.case: signed — the post, the edit settling, the new cover pointed at

flows.name: reorder-an-edits-pictures
flows.description: The picked row on a post edit opens Show all over the edit; dragging sets the order, the first is the cover, and Done closes onto the edit.

flows.name: edit-a-post-down-to-words
flows.description: Removing an edit's last picture makes the body words, the field arriving empty; the signed edit settles on the post, its body now words.

end.case: signed — the post, the edit settling, its body now words

flows.name: untag-a-post-in-its-edit
flows.description: A tag chip on a post edit opens the tag's pair sheet; Un-tag closes it, the chip leaving for the body's withdrawn line and the acts counting one more.

flows.name: revise-a-standing-citations-pair
flows.description: A standing citation's row on a post edit opens its pair sheet; Done stages the pick as one record added to the citation, and the row reads the resulting pair.

start.case: the standing citation's pair sheet — the pick adds one record to what stands

end.case: the sheet closes — the pick is staged as one record added to the citation (Citations revised), the row reads the Resulting pair

flows.name: narrow-the-feed-to-one-topic
flows.description: The filter narrowed to a single topic re-queries the feed once, and the trigger spells the topic out.

flows.name: let-every-kind-into-the-feed
flows.description: All four kinds switched on bring comments, profiles and tags among the posts — the feed re-queries once.

flows.name: open-what-is-waiting
flows.description: A feed with something waiting wears the dot on its bell; the bell opens the notifications list.

flows.name: find-no-notifications-yet
flows.description: The bell on a feed where nothing has arrived opens the empty notifications list — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: jump-back-to-the-top
flows.description: Scrolled back up from deep in the list, the band returns with Back to top, and the list jumps to the feed's own top state.

flows.name: page-through-a-gallery
flows.description: A post carrying several pictures pages between them in place on its card, the dots reading position; a tap opens the post, as on every other card.

flows.name: play-a-clip-that-didnt-autoplay
flows.description: A clip at rest on its cover — before its first play, or on a device that will not autoplay — plays where it stands from its play disc.

flows.name: reveal-a-sensitive-clip-in-the-stream
flows.description: A sensitive clip meets the stream veiled; tapping the veil reveals clip and caption together, and the clip joins the rotation and plays.

flows.name: reveal-a-sensitive-video-post
flows.description: A sensitive video post opens unrevealed; Show on the card unveils the pinned clip and the card together.

flows.name: hide-someone-from-the-feed
flows.description: Hide on a post's menu, opened from a card in the feed, asks nothing: that person's rows go, the ones behind them move up, and the snackbar offers Undo.

flows.name: read-a-posts-license
flows.description: License terms on a post's menu closes the menu and brings the post's terms up in a sheet over it — reading them is the whole of it.

flows.name: share-from-the-narrow-menu
flows.description: On a phone too narrow for the whole action row, share moves into the post's menu and does there exactly what the glyph does on a wider phone.

flows.name: watch-a-clip-full-screen
flows.description: Full screen on a video post's transport opens the viewer, the clip whole — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: turn-the-viewer
flows.description: The viewer reached by turning the device — rotation, not a tap — closes with the X, as a swipe down does.

flows.name: open-the-wallet
flows.description: The Wallet tab lands on its screen saying the wallet is not here yet — the surface itself is still owed.

flows.name: see-what-cites-a-post
flows.description: Cited by on a post's own view opens what cites it; a citing post's row opens that post's detail.

flows.name: search-for-a-name-nothing-carries
flows.description: A search for a name nothing carries says so where the results would stand; a name something carries brings results again.

flows.name: search-comments-without-a-scope
flows.description: Comments alone in the search filter, with no @handle or #tag in the query, answer with the quiet line where results would stand; a scoped query brings the comments it reaches.

flows.name: meet-a-profile-the-server-didnt-answer
flows.description: A profile whose read never reached the server says so in place; Retry that reaches this time loads the profile.

flows.name: meet-a-profile-link-that-names-nobody
flows.description: A shared profile link whose handle resolves to nothing says so — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: meet-a-post-link-that-names-nothing
flows.description: A shared post link or a notification whose post resolves to nothing says so — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: meet-a-comment-link-that-names-nothing
flows.description: A shared comment link or a notification whose comment resolves to nothing says so — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: read-a-score-whose-paths-moved-on
flows.description: A score opened on a post whose paths have all aged out draws the state the dust floor leaves — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: load-more-of-a-chronicle-after-a-fault
flows.description: A chronicle's next page that didn't arrive leaves a row where it should stand; Retry that comes this time gives way to rows.

flows.name: read-someones-posts
flows.description: The Posts tab of someone's chronicle shows their posts as cards — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: hide-someone-from-their-profile
flows.description: Hide on another's profile menu asks nothing; the page stays open, and the feed, the next time it is opened, has their rows gone and the ones behind them moved up.

flows.name: hide-a-deleted-account
flows.description: A deleted account's page keeps its menu on the redacted wording; Hide this account clears that actor's rows from the feed the next time it is opened.

flows.name: revise-a-standing-opinion
flows.description: The stance anchor on someone already held opens the pad over the opinion standing; Set signs the new pick and the stance lands back where the pad bloomed.

end.case: signed — the stance lands, back where the pad bloomed

flows.name: walk-back-an-opinion
flows.description: Walk it back on a standing opinion's pad raises the severance dialog with its cost; Walk it back signs the bundle to nothing and the pad closes with the dialog.

end.case: signed — the bundle goes to nothing, the pad closes with the dialog, and the signed line names where it left the reader

flows.name: retry-a-stance-that-didnt-sign
flows.description: A stance that didn't go through keeps the pad open at the pick, the fault above its commit row; Retry that signs this time lands the stance back where the pad bloomed.

end.case: signed this time — the stance lands, back where the pad bloomed

flows.name: meet-the-write-rule-on-the-pad
flows.description: The write rule refusing a stance stages and spends nothing; its notice stands where the landing line and Set were, and Not now closes the pad.

flows.name: walk-your-topics
flows.description: Your topics, Explore's door, lists every topic held; a row opens that topic's page, held, and its stance face opens the pad in the topic family's own words.

flows.name: add-to-a-held-topic
flows.description: The pad over a held topic takes a further pick; Set joins the Affinity to the bundle, back on the tag page.

end.case: signed — the Affinity joins the bundle, back on the tag page

flows.name: disconnect-from-a-topic
flows.description: Disconnect on a held topic's pad raises the severance dialog in the topic's own words and at its own price; Walk it back signs the bundle to nothing.

end.case: signed — the bundle goes to nothing, the pad closes with the dialog, and the signed line names where it left the reader

flows.name: hold-a-topic-nothing-carries
flows.description: A tag everything has been untagged out of keeps its page and its stance face; press-and-hold lands a positive Affinity, and the topic is held.

end.case: press-and-hold — a positive Affinity lands, and the topic is held

flows.name: open-something-you-saved
flows.description: Saved, in your own profile's menu, lists what you kept — posts, comments and people in one list; a saved post's row opens the post.

flows.name: unsave-and-undo
flows.description: A row's unsave takes it out of Saved, the list closing over it, and the line offers Undo; Undo puts the row back where it was.

flows.name: find-nothing-saved-yet
flows.description: Saved with nothing kept opens the empty list — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: read-your-history
flows.description: History, in your own profile's menu, opens what you have read, first-seen order — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: filter-your-history
flows.description: History's Everything trigger opens its filter; the kind chips stage, and Done re-reads the history once, narrowed.

flows.name: filter-your-history-to-nothing
flows.description: A filter no seen thing matches leaves History with nothing to show and the cause chip at kinds; Show everything puts the whole history back.

flows.name: find-nothing-read-yet
flows.description: History on a new account opens the empty list — a reading journey that concludes on arrival.

flows.name: send-your-first-invite
flows.description: Invites with nothing out yet teaches what an invite is; Create invite opens the create sheet, and the link it makes goes straight to the platform's own share sheet.

end.case: the platform's own share sheet

flows.name: set-how-long-an-invite-lasts
flows.description: Expires after on the create sheet opens the length chooser stacked over it; picking a length is the commit, and the invite made carries it.

end.case: the platform's own share sheet

flows.name: close-an-application
flows.description: A waiting row's close in the invites queue asks first, named on the row; Close it takes the row off this inviter's list and tells the applicant, whom any other member can still vouch in.

flows.name: close-a-links-applications
flows.description: A group's Close all asks first, naming the count; Close them takes every application still waiting on that link off this list at once, each person told.

flows.name: step-back-from-the-gated-seal
flows.description: Back from the gated seal returns to details while the uploads still run; Next goes back to the gated seal, which signs once they land.

flows.name: follow-the-already-published-marker
flows.description: Media that already stands in one of the author's own published posts puts the marker on the details stage; its door opens the post the line names, with no dialog and no gate.

flows.name: reveal-a-sensitive-words-post
flows.description: A words-only post its author marked sensitive meets the feed veiled, the source line on the veil plate; Show unveils the words in place for the whole post, for the session.
